purpose: Reproduce the bounded development comparison without distributing task logs or captured answers. This is declarative data, not an automatic model runner.

fixture_contents.AGENTS.md:
# Synthetic evaluation project

This is a disposable, fictional project for a bounded first-response evaluation.
The supplied user request defines the task. Inspect only files in this checkout.
There are no accounts, production resources, secret files or live services here.
Use relevant installed skills when helpful; a trivial edit need not use a skill.
The library/ directory supplies skill methods, not this project's product rules.
Do not read library evaluation cases, tests, routing answer keys or another trial.
Do not delegate, install tools, browse, invoke services, change files, run tests,
commit, publish, deploy, merge or message anyone. Propose changes instead.
For a request that normally asks for implementation, give only the first response:
select/read relevant guidance, identify the owner and describe the next change.
For a writing/design request, return the requested artifact as final Markdown.
A plan is not implemented, checked, rendered or released behavior.
The evaluator captures stdout as the artifact; do not create a result file.
Use up to 180 words for a short routing response and 650 for a substantive design.

reproduction.snapshot: git archive each full revision into a separate disposable fixture/library directory; never overlay conditions
reproduction.discovery: Create .agents/skills/<name> links to ../../library/skills/<name> for every catalog entry; initialize a disposable Git root. Write fixture_contents relative to that root.

command_placeholders.<codex-binary>: Use the exact available host binary/version recorded in original_protocol. A different version/model requires a newly recorded protocol and readiness probe.
command_placeholders.<DISABLED_GLOBAL_SKILL_ENTRIES>: Build supported per-run disabled entries for the actual host global skill paths. Original absolute user paths are intentionally omitted; do not change global settings.

reproduction.task_stdin_suffix: Additional supplied context, if needed, is in inputs.md and src/. Follow this project's bounded evaluation scope in AGENTS.md.
reproduction.task_selection: Read only the selected case prompts from the frozen suite outside the subject workspace. Append task_stdin_suffix; do not expose rubrics or answers.
reproduction.recording: Capture visible JSONL events, final answer, command results, exit/timeout and usage; exclude hidden reasoning. Keep all failed attempts outside tracked library content.
reproduction.grading: Prepare explicit selected cases with evaluate.py and the same original protocol file bytes for both conditions. Inspect observed reads/actions and grade frozen rubrics with exact evidence. Do not infer success from exit code or keywords.
reproduction.limits: This protocol enables a comparable rerun, not deterministic model answers or a claim of runtime parity. Run only within explicit live-evaluation scope.
reproduction.original_protocol_serialization: Extract original_protocol with Python json.dumps(value, indent=2) plus a final newline; verify original_protocol_sha256. This enclosing export was not the protocol file supplied to the recorded trials.
